methods: Full text source reads recorded incrementally, including completion ranges for initially partial files.
Assembly variants partly reviewed by full differential inspection and explicit equality/control-flow checks against already-read variants. Equivalent lines not independently serial-reread.
PNG assets visually inspected; SVG assets rendered and visually inspected, not full XML security audit. Tracked symbolic links reviewed as link payload and pinned target relationship.
license_boundary: GPL-3.0 project retained as reference only; nested license texts inventoried separately. No source imported into rrrah production.
useful_design_lessons: Staged hashing, bounded I/O and explicit cancellation need measured resource/runtime qualification.
Exact file dedup requires byte confirmation, physical identity handling and fresh mutation checks.
Directory grouping must preserve multiplicities; XOR/count summaries alone do not establish content equality.
EOF and readable result streams do not prove successful scan completion; propagate IO/process failures and cancellation.
Literal filenames, portable canonical hash storage, state alignment and error-aware cache/replay behavior require direct controls.
material_findings: Executed readdir EIO control lost terminal error in original traversal.
Executed directory-signature equality accepted differing content multiplicities.
Original GUI controls demonstrated stale filtering, ambiguous EOF/success and parsing failures.
French active translation introduced an extra format placeholder in replay warning; erroneous variadic call not executed.
Hash-many x86 assembly contains wider loads beyond logical block in certain tails; no guard-page reproduction/caller allocation qualification.
Unix AVX512 xof_many count0 enters64-byte scalar store path; public caller reachability unverified.
limits: Full upstream test suite not run; isolated original-code controls are distinct from full rmlint runtime qualification.
No complete Windows/Linux/filesystem-race/GUI/package/release/platform coverage, SIMD runtime parity or throughput acceptance.
289 source/visual credits do not prove duplicate library covers all cases.
External linked videos and documentation URLs are not tracked tree blobs and were not all viewed.
